thread:
Elaine: Heads up — vendor flagged an in-bond AWB hold on 50x A800s we committed for next-week provisioning. Customs requesting HS reclass + commercial invoice before release. This will bottleneck capacity if not cleared.
Mike: Ugh. ETA on clearance? Any immediate uplift cost? :eyes:
Anu: Forwarder says 48–72h pending docs. AWB 771-12345678. They can re-doc to 'in-bond release' but courier charges an amendment fee + brokerage (~$12k est).
Simon: Also got a vendor note: 6 units reported DOA on the manifest. They need serials + RMA labels to start swap flow. If we want replacements flown, that'll add expedite fees.
Rosa: If provisioning slips we risk Dedicated pool SLOs for a handful of customers. Can we borrow from eu-edge or enable routing to other regions?
Elaine: @Mike can you pause payment release until we get a confirmed HS and invoice? Need procurement leverage for cost share.
Mike: I'll hold the wire for now. Vendor, please provide commercial invoice and HS code. We need photos of DOA units to approve expedite.
Anu: Sending docs request to forwarder and customs contact now. Contact: customs-ams@fwd.example.com. AWB/manifest snippet:```AWB: 771-12345678
Pieces: 50
Weight: 3600kg
Shipper: VendorCo BV
Consignee: Redwood Inference EU (inbond)```
Simon: Uploading the serial manifest in a sec. For the 6 DOA, vendor suggests immediate air-ship replacements from their DE pool, or depot swap (longer). They offered 50% uplift on expedited freight if we cover brokerage.
Elaine: We should push vendor to cover brokerage or at least split 60/40. Also ask them to pre-generate RMA labels so depot can accept on arrival.
Rosa: On the infra side, I'll open temporary routing: scale down a few non-critical workloads and shift high-priority models to hosted until hardware available. That gives us ~12–24h buffer.
Mike: Vendor just replied: commercial invoice attached (sent to procurement@). HS code they've used: 8471.80 but customs wants clarifying docs because of MBOM differences.
Anu: Customs flagged mismatched description vs invoice. They want a packing list with serial ranges and MPNs. If vendor provides same-day packing list, release can be same-day.
Simon: I'll push vendor to generate packing list + serial CSV and prepay part of amendment fee. Also asking them to commit to sending 6 replacement AWBs tonight if we approve expedite.
logistics-bot: AWB 771-12345678 status: customs_pending -> docs_requested. ETA clearance delta estimate: 48 hours.
Elaine: Can we do a split shipment for the DOA replacements (air) and the rest sea? That reduces immediate uplift.
Mike: Agree. Approve split if vendor covers at least 50% of expedite cost. I'll set approval once I see the packing list and the vendor commit.
Rosa: Reminder: add routing rule to fail over to model-variant-2 in region if pod count drops below threshold — I'll push the change.
Simon: Vendor confirmed packing list + serial CSV uploaded to shared bucket and agreed to 50% expedite. They also generated provisional RMA labels for the 6 units.
Elaine: Great. Mike I'll need confirmation you released 50% of the amendment fee to forwarder once customs confirms.
Mike: Will release up to $6k upon docs verification. Vendor please ping when customs confirms.
Anu: Forwarder says once we accept the amendment, customs will start automatic processing. They advised to include HS explanatory note: 'GPU accelerator modules, model A800 — computing device, commodity code 8471.80 — serials included.'
Simon: Noted. Vendor will add that to the invoice. They'll also overnight 6 AWBs for replacements if customs clears the manifest today.
Rosa: I'll monitor SLO impact and post updates in #eng-sre if we need to scale fallbacks further.
Elaine: Thanks all. Will track until AWB clears. :thumbsup:
